crossRefs.note: Now please let the power of the Lord be great, according as you have spoken, saying,
So they put sackcloth on their bodies and ropes on their heads, and came to the king of Israel, and said, “Your servant…
Now the men observed diligently, and hurried to take this phrase; and they said, “Your brother Ben Hadad.” Then he…
Oh that I knew where I might find him! That I might come even to his seat!
I would set my cause in order before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.
Yahweh said, “If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare the whole place for their sake.”
He spoke to him yet again, and said, “What if there are forty found there?” He said, “I will not do it for the forty’s…

translations.web: What if there will lack five of the fifty righteous? Will you destroy all the city for lack of five?” He said, “I will not destroy it if I find forty-five there.”
translations.bsb: suppose the fifty righteous ones lack five. Will You destroy the whole city for the lack of five?” He replied, “If I find forty-five there, I will not destroy it.”
